stream_areal_density — DRIVE scoop op

• Data kinds: image2d × scalar → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.stream_areal_density(coverage, radius_px: 'float', *, c_max: 'float' = 0.95, mode: 'str' = 'raise') -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import scoop; scoop.stream_areal_density(coverage, radius_px: 'float', *, c_max: 'float' = 0.95, mode: 'str' = 'raise') -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("stream_areal_density"))

Usage

Inverts the Boolean model to get the areal density of particle centers [particles / px²] from the coverage, n = −ln(1 − c) / (π r²).

The coverage of a union of independently placed discs of radius r is c = 1 − exp(−n π r²) (overlaps are not undercounted). The naive c / (π r²) undercounts by nearly a factor of 2 at c = 0.8 (PoC gate). As c approaches 1 the inverse diverges (a thick stream hides what is behind it):

mode="raise" raises ValueError if any pixel has c ≥ c_max, "clip" clips to c_max (giving a lower-bound estimate). In dense streams where grain positions are not independent (near the outlet, grains touching) the model fails —— a limitation. Raises ValueError: not a coverage fraction / saturated (mode="raise") / misspelling.
